name: PowerX, Inc.
summary: PowerX, Inc. manufactures and sells energy storage systems. It provides stationary energy storage systems, including PowerX Mega Power; PowerX cube for grid-mounted batteries, renewable energy-integrated batteries, and industrial and commercial batteries; and PowerX Hypercharger for commercial EV charging/public charging infrastructure applications, as well as battery tankers for maritime business. The company also offers electricity supply and aggregation services, as well as electric vehicle charging services. In addition, it provides services through PowerX app. PowerX, Inc. was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Tamano, Japan.
